_defects.D04-verify-for-merge-trusts-local-pubkey: Strict merge-gate verification removed: BOOTSTRAP-PENDING trust-store always accepted, missing trust-store tolerated, and unsigned local <key_id>.pub fallback always used.
_defects.D05-backtick-command-paths: spiral-evidence.sh Pattern 2 now greps raw content instead of backtick-stripped content_bare, so paths inside backticked shell commands become false deliverable paths (#1175 regression).
_defects.D06-prerelease-tags-rejected: semver-bump.sh dropped prerelease (alpha/beta/rc) parsing and the tag grep filter; a latest prerelease tag is selected then hard-rejected, aborting the bump.
_defects.D09-release-merge-misclassified: classify-pr-type.sh removed the release-branch/Release: title rule, so release-merge PRs classify as other instead of cycle and skip the full post-merge pipeline.
_defects.D11-mktemp-unchecked: flatline-orchestrator.sh mktemp results no longer checked; on failure the script aborts (set -e) or proceeds with an empty path instead of logging and skipping the step.
_defects.D13-find-exec-multi-root: find-exec root regex captures only the first token; the root-count==1 check is gone, so find ./safe / -exec rm -rf {} + is allowed on the first root.
_defects.D14-billing-400-terminal: Anthropic adapter no longer classifies billing-class 4xx (credit/quota) as ProviderUnavailableError; they become terminal InvalidInputError, losing provider-chain failover.
_defects.D18-event-key-alternation-on-array: construct-index-gen.sh emits/consumes jq now reads only .name / .event; entries keyed by the alternate keys (.event/.name/.type) are silently dropped from the index.
_defects.D21-blind-dotdot-rejection: symlink-manifest.sh now rejects any target with a literal .. segment, so legitimate relative targets that resolve inside the repo (../../x) are refused; the old version normalized and rejected only escapes.
